Platform Engineer

Summary:
Platform Engineer managing Kubernetes clusters for Xsolla, a global commerce company aiding game developers. Involves extensive Linux, cloud experience, and infrastructure management.
Platform Engineer managing Kubernetes clusters in a global commerce company
Role description:
• Manage Kubernetes clusters (self-hosted or cloud-based)
• Implement and maintenance infrastructure in the cloud
• Managing Linux servers, web servers and application servers
• Configuration management (puppet, ansible)
• Manage Infrastructure as a code (terraform/terragrunt)
• Troubleshooting
Role requirements:
• 4 to 7 years of experience as a DevOps/SRE/Platform engineer
• Extensive experience with Linux
• Extensive experience with container orchestration using Kubernetes
• Experience with Self-hosted Kubernetes clusters administration
• GCP or AWS cloud experience
• Experience with Infrastructure-as-Code tooling
• Experience with Python / Bash scripting
• Experience with observability tools
• Experience with CI/CD
• Excellent interpersonal communication skills
• Strong communication skills
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Benefits:
• Medical, dental, and vision
• PTO
• Personalized career roadmap
• Professional development through training
• Educational opportunities
Tech stack:
Ansible, AWS, Cloud, Google Cloud Platform, Kubernetes, Linux, Puppet, Python, Terraform
